item.title: U.S. SpaceForce’s SpaceWERX Awards Casimir Inc. STTR Phase I Award
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Casimir, Inc., a quantum energy technology company, announced it has been selected by SpaceWERX for a STTR Phase I contract focused on developing Casimir’s fully independent solid-state generator to address the most pressing challenges in the Department of the Air Force (DAF).
